basis: OOS 2022-2026 (1764d) net of costs+funding; 60d block bootstrap x2000

regime_conditioning.note: Gate edge = crash insurance. In windows WITH a >50pct BTC bear (2022), gate adds ~60pp/yr; in bull windows (2023-24) it COSTS ~30-100pp/yr of upside; in chop (2025-26) roughly neutral-to-slightly-positive.

variants_evaluated_this_study: fund_z regression x2 horizons x3 periods
multiple_testing_ledger.selection_statement: Primary gate (SMA200) chosen a priori; alternates reported, not selected. No parameter was optimized on returns. Nevertheless the gate's incremental value is only ~p=0.14-0.25 vs no-gate: treat the effect as economically-motivated insurance, not a high-t alpha.
multiple_testing_ledger.relation_to_prior_trend_failures: Prior #2 used trend as RETURN signal at 4h/daily. Here trend is a 0/1 RISK GATE on unconditional long drift; it never predicts up-moves, it only refuses to hold below the 200d. Different mechanism; still, evidence base is ~2 bears (2022 full avoidance, 2025-26 partial).
